'''Sector Development''' was a series of agencies under the auspices of the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order's]] [[Coalition for Improvements/Legends|Coalition for Improvements]].<ref name="ISB" /> Responsible for overseeing the development of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] territories,<ref name="J1">{{JournalCite|1|Lan Barell (article)}}</ref> the resources made available to each [[Sector/Legends|sector]] agency varied as priorities for short term projects were given priority funding. To combat this, sector agencies initiated many low cost, long term development strategies, which they would then pour available funds into those promising the greatest return. Sector Development contained two separate departments with specific mandates; the [[Department of Modification]], and the [[Department of Redesign]].<ref name="ISB" />
